messages.en: What are you doing!!
I'm getting off workkk
I'm leaving the country tomorrowww
There’s been more content coming out lately,

messages.ko: Y/n가 쉴새없이 나 볼수있어서 너무 좋은거같아
messages.en: so I think it's really nice that Y/n can see me nonstop.
Tiki-Taka will be coming out soon too,
It's a different kind of fun from Magic Girl.
It's a talk show,
and it was so much fun even while we were filming,
so look forward to it.
Soomin, Hyerin, and Hayeon are on it,
Soomin appears throughout,
and Hyerin and I each appear for about half of it.
Come to think of it,
Did you only take the phones from three people?
The comments on the drive.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Hmm, that wasn't me~
The night air is cold.
The members have been struggling with colds lately too.

messages.ko: Y/n 옷 잘 챙겨입구 사람 많은곳 갈때는 마스크 써
messages.en: Y/n, dress warmly, and wear a mask when you go somewhere crowded.
You could catch something, you know.
I'm still full of energy.
It's a busy time, and being sick would be so hard.
I'm taking even stricter care of my health.
If you feel even a little worn out or exhausted,
try getting an IV drip.
Even if you're not feeling terribly sick, getting one
definitely makes you feel better.
I'm scared of needles.
You're such a baby.
But IV drips are so expensive.
You shouldn't skimp on spending money on your own health.
I like getting shots.
I even just watch the blood come out.
I watch the IV fluid going in too.
I just find it so fascinating.
So that Y/n won't get sick,
I'll prescribe something for you.
Hayeon's medicine prescription
Look at this and don't get sick😳
Lately, I think I look so pretty without bangs,
so I've been pinning them back a lot.
Pretty, right?
It gives me a different vibe.
With bangs, I look cute and round, like a Coco Ball,
but with them pushed back, I look a little more mature and round.
I should switch between different hairstyles.
I still haven't packed my bags.
What should I bring?
I always carry that with me,
in my heart.
Do I just need to bring Y/n?

messages.ko: 그럼 양치도 시켜주고 옷도 세팅해주고 붓기도 알아서 빼주는거임?
messages.en: Then will you brush my teeth for me, pick out my clothes, and even take care of my puffiness for me?
Wow, I'm really sorry.
As soon as I arrive,
I'll start packing right away.
What else should I pack?
Aren't you going to have to leave with almost no sleep?
That's right.
But it's okay.
I can get some sleep on the plane.
Finish packing quickly and get at least a little sleep.
I should do that.
I'll be an airport goddess tomorrow~
Goodnight!
Haranghae😍😍
